findings.evidence: Mathlib `Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/FDeriv/Measurable.lean:404` `stronglyMeasurable_deriv (f : 𝕜 → F) : StronglyMeasurable (deriv f)` and `:416` `aestronglyMeasurable_deriv`; both already instantiated at ℝ → ℂ in this repo: `TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Winding/Continuity.lean:57` (`AEStronglyMeasurable.mul ?_ (aestronglyMeasurable_deriv γ _)`) and `TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Dixon/H1Diff.lean:77` (`(stronglyMeasurable_deriv γ).aestronglyMeasurable`).
findings.fix: Use `aemeasurable_deriv γ _` / `aestronglyMeasurable_deriv γ _` directly: `(Complex.imCLM.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (((hγc.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Icc).mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono huIoc_sub le_rfl)).aemeasurable.sub_const s).inv.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (aestronglyMeasurable_deriv γ _)).congr ...`, and drop `haesm`, `hcongr`, `hcp`, `hqd`, the `hdw'` hypothesis, the `h_sub_cd` hypothesis and the `c`, `d` parameters; the lemma then needs only `hpq`, `h_sub_bdd`, `ContinuousOn γ (Icc p q)`, `hbdd`. The two call sites (lines 294-300) then stop passing `(hlipL t ht').continuousOn` / `(hlipR t ht').continuousOn`.
findings.issue: `intervalIntegrable_realWindingIntegrand_window` obtains a.e. strong measurability of `t ↦ realWindingIntegrand (γ t - s) (deriv γ t)` by building it for `derivWithin γ (Icc c d)` (`haesm`, lines 130-144) and then transporting along an a.e. congruence `derivWithin = deriv` off the piece endpoints (`hcongr`, lines 145-154). Measurability of `deriv γ` is unconditional in Mathlib and needs none of this.

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'derivWithin_congr_set' TauCeti/` returns exactly these four occurrences (PwC1ImmersionOn.lean:228, 246, 286, 327), all four discharging the same statement with only the names of the two right (resp. left) endpoints changed.
findings.fix: Add one private lemma `derivWithin_Icc_left_endpoint_congr {γ} {t d d' : ℝ} (hd : t < d) (hd' : t < d') : derivWithin γ (Icc t d) t = derivWithin γ (Icc t d') t` and its left mirror `{c c' t}`, and call them at all four sites (in the shrink lemmas, `hEqOn`'s first branch becomes a single application after `rw [← heq]`).
findings.issue: The fact `derivWithin γ (Icc t d) t = derivWithin γ (Icc t d') t` (for `t < d`, `t < d'`) is proved from scratch by the same `derivWithin_congr_set` + `Iio_mem_nhds (lt_min ..)` block twice on the right (lines 227-235 in `derivWithin_ne_zero_right`, lines 285-293 in `exists_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_shrink_right`'s `hEqOn`) and twice on the left (lines 245-253, lines 326-334), i.e. four near-identical 8-line copies of one lemma.

summary: Two reuse defects: the new window-integrability helper re-derives measurability of `deriv γ` through a `derivWithin` congruence when Mathlib's `aestronglyMeasurable_deriv` (already used elsewhere in this repo) gives it outright, and the same `derivWithin_congr_set` endpoint argument is written out four times in `PwC1ImmersionOn.lean` instead of being factored into one lemma plus its mirror. No duplicated public results found otherwise.
